AddAdoPatRequest.description: A personal access token (Code and Work Items, read and write), and optionally the commit name and email.

AdoConnectionVm.description:
A person's Azure DevOps connection (never the token). `failed`: reconnect (`lastError` says why). `kind`:
`OAuth` or `Pat`. `commitName`/`commitEmail`: what they set; `authorName`/`authorEmail`: what their
commits get (null: no email yet, so agentd's).

AdoConnectionsVm.description: `available`: the Entra app is set up (Settings → Azure DevOps → Service principal), so people can connect.

url.description: The S3 API URL ending with the bucket (`https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/agentd`).

publicUrl.description: The bucket's public domain (`https://agentd.example.com`); empty links pages to agentd.

accessKeyId.description: A new access key ID; empty keeps the stored one.

secretAccessKey.description: A new secret access key; empty keeps the stored one.

folder.description: Without S3, pages are HTML files here (absolute or under ~/); empty goes back to the default.

ArtifactStorageRequest.description: Artifact storage. An empty `Url` keeps new pages in the database; empty keys keep the saved ones.

ArtifactStorageStepVm.description:
Where artifacts are stored: the S3 API URL (none: the database) and the public domain links use; the keys as statuses.
`urlOverriddenBy` / `publicUrlOverriddenBy` name what supplies a value over agentd.json.

ArtifactVm.description: An artifact: open `url` (a page of its own: agentd's, or the bucket's public domain for a page in S3); `source` (job, chat, idea, review, review-session, watch, web) and `sourceId` say which agent published it.

pat.description: A new token; empty keeps the stored one.

clientSecret.description: A new client secret; empty keeps the stored one.

AzureDevOpsRequest.description: `Auth` is `Pat` or `AzCli`. An empty `Pat` keeps the saved one.

AzureDevOpsStepVm.description: `Auth` is `Pat`, `AzCli`, `Entra` or `ServicePrincipal` (tenant and client ids; the client secret as a status only).

ChatDetailVm.description: A chat and its whole conversation; `thinking`: the agent is writing an answer.

ChatMessageVm.description: One message: `in` from a person; `out` from the agent (author `agent`, Markdown) or agentd (`agentd`).

ChatRequest.description: Discord settings. An empty `BotToken` keeps the saved one; `UserName` + `UserDiscordId` add you as a user.

ChatStartedVm.description: A new chat: its page is `/chats/{id}`.

ChatStepVm.description: The chat step (Discord): the server and channel IDs, the bot token's status, and who agentd answers there.

ChatSummaryVm.description: A chat: its first question is the title; `inChat`: it also has a chat thread.

ClaudeLoginVm.description: Claude Code on this server: installed, its version, and whether a subscription is logged in there.

ClaudeStepVm.description: The Claude step: the stored `claude setup-token` token (status only) and the server's own login.

ClaudeTokenRequest.description: A token from `claude setup-token`. On Test, empty means "the saved one, else the server's login".

CommitAuthorRequest.description: The name and email on the person's commits; blank goes back to their profile's.

ConfigVm.description: Read-only settings. Explicit fields only: tokens, keys and secrets have no way in.

ConversationEntryVm.description: A conversation line: `direction` is `out` (agentd) or `in` (a developer's reply or command, by `author`).

DatabaseRequest.description: The PostgreSQL connection string (a secret). On Test, empty means "the saved one".

DiffVm.description: A job's changes; `unifiedDiff` is null when `truncated` (over 2 MB), leaving the file list.

DiskVm.description: A mounted disk; `home`: it holds agentd's home (worktrees, logs).

EventVm.description: One event; the payload is JSON passed through (it was redacted when stored).

FinishVm.description: Setup is complete; the daemon uses the new settings after a restart.

worktrees.description: The worktree root; empty: the default in agentd's home.

repositories.description: The clones' folder; empty: the default.

FoldersStepVm.description: Settings → Folders: the worktree root and the clones' folder as written (`~` not expanded), and what overrides each.

GitKeyStepVm.description: agentd's SSH key for git: the public key to add in Azure DevOps or GitHub, and its fingerprint. Never the private key.

GitTestRequest.description: A repository's clone URL (SSH for agentd's key).

GuideCallout.description:
Something the human reviewer should know about the change even when nothing is wrong (from pi-review's "human reviewer
callouts"): Kind is one of GuideCalloutKinds, Detail says what and where.

title.description: What this part of the change is, in a few words.

why.description: What it does and why it matters, in one to three sentences.

files.description: The changed files it covers, in reading order.

attention.description: string GuideAttention.Core (read closely) or string GuideAttention.Skim.

focus.description: What to check while reading it, a few short points.

summary.description: What changed in it, in one sentence (none for files agentd added to "Everything else").

GuideNote.description: What a line does and why, for someone new to the code; Critical: a spot that needs care.

GuideSuggestion.description: An improvement worth considering: clearer, simpler, safer later. Shown apart from findings.

HistoryPageVm.description: A history page; `totalCapped` means "more than `total`" (shown as 10,000+).

deleteThread.description: Delete the idea's chat thread; otherwise it's archived.

messages.description: The whole conversation, including agentd's own notices.

thinking.description: The agent is writing a reply.

hasThread.description: It has a chat thread (Close… can delete or archive it).

text.description: A message, or a choice once work items are proposed (✅ Create, 🚀 Create and start, ✏️ Change, 🗑 Discard).

IdeaMessageVm.description: One message of the idea's conversation: `in` from a person, `out` from the agent (Markdown).

model.description: From the next reply; none keeps the current one.

effort.description: From the next reply; none keeps the current one.

IdeaStartedVm.description: A new idea: its page is `/ideas/{id}`.

InboxCountsVm.description: How many threads wait on you, and how many have messages you haven't read.

InboxItemVm.description: One of agentd's messages in a thread (Markdown).

InboxOptionVm.description: A button of a question: send its `label` as the reply.

InboxPageVm.description: The Inbox: its threads (waiting on you first, then unread, then the rest) and the nav's counts.

text.description: The answer: a question's option, or anything you'd write in the source's chat thread or page.

InboxReplyVm.description: A reply's outcome, as the source answered it.

InboxThreadVm.description: A thread in the list; `question` is its latest question while it waits on someone.

JobResourcesVm.description: A running job's agent process tree (CPU is percent of one core) and its worktree size.

JobSummaryVm.description: A job row (dashboard, history). State and statuses are strings for the UI.

MachineDetailsVm.description: Cores, load averages (null: unknown), swap, uptime in seconds, and each real disk.

MachineVm.description: The machine agentd runs on (null fields: not sampled, e.g. off Linux).

outcome.description: permission, close_out, follow_up (answered in the thread and Conversation), resumed, queued, fix_round or handoff_declined.

OpenPullRequestsVm.description: The registered repositories' active PRs, newest first; `failed`: repositories that couldn't be read.

PermissionRequestVm.description: A tool call outside the agent's allowlist, waiting for a person (`ruleKeys`: what "allow for this job / always" remembers).

PermissionRuleVm.description: A remembered approval; `jobId` null means every job of the repository.

PostedFindingVm.description: A posted finding and its status on the PR.

PostedVm.description:
A Send to a PR as it stands: each posted finding's status (`open`, `fixed`, `closed`) and the re-checks after
pushes, newest last. `done` once the PR completed or was abandoned.

ProfileRequest.description: A provider (Anthropic-compatible endpoint). An empty `ApiKey` keeps the saved one.

ProfileVm.description: Another provider: endpoint and models; the API key as a status only.

PromptConversationPageVm.description: A page of conversations, the latest activity first; `hasMore`: ask again with `before` = the last `lastId`.

PromptConversationVm.description: A conversation: every turn for one source, the latest's outcome, whether one runs, the models used; `preview` starts its first prompt.

PromptDetailVm.description: A prompt, whole: what was sent, the system rules with it, and the reply.

PromptPageVm.description: A page, newest first; `hasMore`: older prompts exist (ask again with `before` = the last id).

PromptSummaryVm.description: A prompt in the list; `preview` is its first 300 characters, `outcome` null while it runs.

RepositoryEntryVm.description: A repository in `agentd.json`; the daemon registers and clones it at start.

RepositoryProblemVm.description: A repository whose PRs couldn't be listed, and why.

RepositoryRequest.description: A repository to add. Only `Url` is required; the rest defaults like `agentd repo add`.

RestartVm.description: Whether Settings can restart agentd (`reason` says why not), and what a restart would interrupt now.

ReviewAskVm.description: A question and its answer; `threadId` names the thread's first question (none: this one starts a thread).

ReviewDiffVm.description: The pinned change; `unifiedDiff` is null when it's too big (only the file list).

ReviewFileVm.description: A file at the review's head commit, read-only; `truncated`: cut at 512 KB (empty past 8 MB); `binary`: not shown.

ReviewFindingVm.description: A finding and the person's decision about it.

overview.description: What the change does and how it fits together.

before.description: How it worked before the change, in a sentence or two.

callouts.description: Heads-ups for the human reviewer (a migration, a new dependency…): facts, not problems.

ReviewGuide.description:
A guided review (docs/architect/review-sessions.md §2a): the change explained in reading order. Chapters go by importance
(the heart of the change, then its consequences, then the glue), each with why it matters and a line per file; notes
explain lines (not problems); suggestions are optional improvements (not findings: nothing breaks without them).

ReviewItemVm.description: One review line: a step, whether finishing needs it, and its check.

ReviewSearchHitVm.description: A matching line: its file and 1-based line, a snippet, and where the match sits in the snippet.

ReviewSearchVm.description: A search's results: matching file paths (`kind=file`) or matching lines (`kind=text`).

ReviewSentVm.description: What Send did: the text to copy, or the PR it was posted to (under your name when `asPerson`).

ReviewSessionDetailVm.description: A session with its comments and questions, as the review page shows it; `onPullRequest` once it was sent to a PR with findings.

ReviewSessionVm.description: A review session: what it looks at (pinned commits), its state, the reviewer's summary and findings.

RunningWorkVm.description: A job mid-step or an agent's turn: `source` is job, idea, chat or review.

SaveResultVm.description: Saved. The daemon reads these settings at start, so they apply after a restart.

SecretStatusVm.description:
A secret's status. Secrets are write-only: the value never leaves the server. `overriddenBy` names what supplies it
over the secret store (e.g. "Key Vault (my-vault.vault.azure.net)"): change it there, since saving here changes nothing.

destination.description: `pr` (a PR's review: post it there) or `text` (copy it).

SessionRecheck.description: One re-check of a Send: when, at which PR head, and how the posted findings stood after it (or what went wrong).

SetupSessionVm.description: The setup session (the one-time link's cookie): when it ends unless used again (it slides).

repo.description: Only this repository (none: every registered one).

model.description: fable, opus, sonnet or a full name; none = the chat step's default.

effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

repo.description: The repository (optional when only one is registered).

model.description: The brainstorm's model (fable, opus, sonnet or a full name); none = the default.

effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max; none = the default.

branch.description: …or this branch (against its base, or Base)…

base.description: …or from this commit (with Head); for a branch, what it's compared with.

model.description: The reviewer's model; none = the review step's default.

effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max; none = the default.

focus.description: What to look at most, e.g. "security, tests".

StepCheckVm.description: A step's "Test" result; string? StepCheckVm.Fix says what to do when it failed.

StepModelVm.description: One step's model, effort and provider (empty: the defaults).

SystemLogEntryVm.description: One entry; `level` is Trace … Critical, `category` the logger's (e.g. Agentd.Application.Jobs.Scheduler).

SystemLogPageVm.description: A page, newest first; `hasMore`: older entries exist (ask again with `before` = the last id).

UserVm.description: The signed-in user; in Mode None, `{ name: "local", roles: ["Admin"], provider: "local" }`.

WorkItemDraftVm.description: A proposed work item; a task's `parent` is its story's index in the list.

WorkItemVm.description: One work item across its jobs (oldest first), with its PRs and chat threads (open or closed).
